description: CubeWP Forms before 1.1.13 contains an unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious JavaScript by submitting unregistered field names through the public REST route cubewp-custom-form/v1/submit/, which bypasses its own nonce check and saves unsanitized values due to a missing default case in the sanitizer, later rendered unescaped on the admin Leads detail page. Attackers can send a single crafted GET request containing a script payload in a custom form field to execute arbitrary JavaScript in an administrator's wp-admin session when the lead is viewed, enabling full site takeover such as creating a new administrator account.
